data.exact_reserve_text: Overall on an aggregate basis, reserve releases of GBP 1.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2016. In 2015 there was a reserve strengthening of GBP 4.4m. Overall the reserve release in 2016 was primarily generated by the Property account offset by a strengthening of the Professional Liability and Marine account reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: For 2016, Syndicate 2015 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 20.057 million, representing 13.04% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This gross strengthening contrasts with a reported net release of GBP 1.4 million. The strengthening was primarily driven by adverse development in the Marine (specifically 2014 marine cargo business) and Professional Liability accounts, which offset a release of reserves in the Property account. The year also saw significant catastrophe losses, including Hurricane Matthew and the Alberta wildfires, which impacted the property account.
